div.div: مَسْرَجَةٌ , with fet-h (S, Mgh, O, Msb) to the م and ر, (Msb,) [A lamp; i. e.] the thing in which is the wick and the oil: (S, Mgh, O, TA:) and also the thing upon which the سِرَاج [app. here meaning lamp] is put: (O:) or the thing upon which the ↓ مِسْرَجَة is placed: (Msb:) or ↓ مِسْرَجَةٌ , with kesr, has the last of these meanings: مَسْرَجَةٌ, with fet-h, having the first thereof: or, as some say, the reverse is the case; (Mgh;) [i. e.] ↓ مِسْرَجَةٌ , with kesr, signifies the thing in which is the wick [and the oil]: and مَسْرَجَةٌ, with fet-h, the thing upon which that is put: (A, TA:) the pl. (of either, Mgh) is مَسَارِجُ. (Mgh, Msb.) [See also سِرَاجٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
